runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.emptyBody: Once an agent is added to CI and a pull request is reviewed there, the run shows up here. Use “Add to CI” on an agent’s CI tab to get started.
runs.degradedFallback: Refresh was degraded — showing the runs already ingested.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a GitHub repository.
ciTab.empty: This agent is not in CI yet. “Add to CI” opens a pull request that adds the workflow and the agent’s config to a repository.
ciTab.updateNoInstallations: Add the agent to a repository first.
ciTab.updateDiscardNote: Update CI config regenerates the workflow from the stored settings and opens or refreshes a pull request. Any manual edits to the workflow are discarded.
ciTab.noRuns: No CI runs for this agent yet.
ciTab.addRepositoryHint: Add this agent to another repository.
ciTab.failCiOnHint: When this agent's CI run exits non-zero, so a required status check can block the merge. Decided by finding severity, not the model. Takes effect in CI after Update CI config.

exportWizard.title: Add to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repository to add the workflow to
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a pull request in {repo} from the devdigest/ci branch with the {count} generated files.

installStep.zipHint: Downloads a .zip of the previewed files — no pull request is opened and no installation is recorded.

preview.workflowHint: Edit the workflow before installing — your changes carry through to the Install step.

exportWizard.editedNotice: You edited the workflow in Preview, so it no longer follows these choices. The edited workflow will be committed as written.
exportWizard.branchProtectionNote: Blocking a merge needs two things: “Fail CI on” set on the agent, plus this check marked as a required status check in the repository’s branch protection.

secrets.heading: Secrets expected
secrets.intro: Add this secret to the repository before the workflow runs. DevDigest does not read or check it.
secrets.openrouter: Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the repository’s Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions.
secrets.githubToken: GITHUB_TOKEN is provided by GitHub Actions.

exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a pull request with these files
